facts.business: Telge Projects Limited is a global engineering solutions company providing Structural Steel Design & Detailing, Building Information Modelling (BIM), Architectural Services, Construction Documentation, Estimation & Quantity Take-Off, and Project Coordination & Engineering Support to the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note No. 2 regarding the Company's listing on the BSE SME platform during the year and these being the first financial results prepared and presented post-listing.

key_risks: Complex accounting treatments and disclosures related to the Initial Public Offering (IPO) including restatement of prior period financial information
Dependence on global architectural services market cycles and construction industry demand
Technology adoption risks in BIM and digital engineering solutions
Execution and delivery risks across international projects and multiple delivery centers
